categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_eviction.py to properly test connection management and inbound peer eviction protection.
categories.rationale: Fixes a test gap where inbound peer eviction logic for block relayers was completely bypassed due to connection order fallback. As verified by mutation testing, master passed even when block-time protection was removed, which this PR corrects without altering production p2p code.
